scripts.dev:self-hosted: npm run build:self-hosted && wrangler dev --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc
scripts.build:self-hosted: SELF_HOSTED=true vite build && npm --prefix invoicer run build:bundled && node scripts/build-source.mjs
scripts.migrate:self-hosted:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply INVOICER_DB --local --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc
scripts.migrate:self-hosted:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply INVOICER_DB --remote --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc
scripts.deploy:self-hosted: npm run build:self-hosted && npm run migrate:self-hosted:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc
scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-source.mjs && node scripts/bundle-hosted.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix invoicer run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:self-hosted && npm test && npm --prefix invoicer test
scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply phooey-finance --remote --env production
